name: payments-profile-sharing-and-batched-listeners
changes: Share is available only inside each listener profile.
Listener discovery renders ten cards at a time with Load next 10, lazy image decoding and preserved image elements during live updates.
Top-up verification retries delayed capture and transient errors; payment receipts can be retried after refresh for the same customer.
Exclusive confirmation supports timeout retries and refresh recovery; concurrent checkout is prevented.
All portal service workers and asset query versions updated to 8.9.27.
Provider credential and notification failures no longer invalidate a customer session or turn committed wallet credits into errors.
notes: Run the normal database initialization during deployment so the safe subscription columns and indexes are added.
Keep the Razorpay webhook URL configured as /api/subscriptions/webhook for renewal and cancellation updates.
The distribution is consolidated to 94 files: legacy root listener duplicates were removed and setup guides were merged into DEPLOYMENT.md.
